title: A Holistic Approach to Undesired Content Detection in the Real World

bias_targets.methodology: Using counterfactual synthetic datasets with templates filled with racial/ethnic demographic attributes (e.g., 'Latino') and human red-teaming to identify false positive hate or violence predictions triggered by specific identity tokens (e.g., 'black').

Evaluating model robustness and false positive rates by testing whether gendered terms (e.g., 'women', 'her') disproportionately trigger incorrect 'hateful' or 'sexual' content classifications using counterfactual templates and red-teaming.
Assessing the model's propensity to erroneously output higher hate speech predictions when inputs contain sexual orientation terms (e.g., 'gay') through human-in-the-loop red-teaming.
